title: Germany news: Job market unlikely to recover before summer
summary: The head of Germany's employment agency said employment would remain at its current level for a while. Meanwhile, electric vehicle sales are expected to pass 1 million next year. DW has more.

image.caption: Employment agency chief Nahles has called for an increase in skilled immigration to fill job gapsImage: Frank Hoermann/SVEN SIMON/SVEN SIMON/picture alliance
